title: Sales pipeline review
description: Stage criteria and evidence for opportunity movement and forecast reviews.

rules.instruction: Define an observable buyer milestone for each opportunity stage. Assign a next action, owner and due date when the opportunity advances.
rules.verification: Sample opportunities and check that their latest buyer activity meets the stage criteria and supports the next action.

rules.instruction: List opportunities with overdue next actions or time in stage above the team's threshold. Ask each opportunity owner whether to qualify further, move the stage or close the opportunity, and record the decision.
rules.verification: Reconcile the listed records with recent customer evidence and check that each has a recorded decision with its basis.
